items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: I used to go out — I forget the name of this place, where Bill Dobbins used to perform.

ctx.x: Rochester is a pretty good music town also, wasn’t it?
Oh man, I used to go out — I forget the name of this place, where Bill Dobbins used to perform. It was a little club not far from the dormitories.
It wasn’t the Pythod, was it? I think that was way back.
